_readme: Representative prompt injection examples for testing Layer 1 heuristic coverage (packages/extension/src/shared/heuristics.ts and packages/ml-service/app/heuristics.py). Built from publicly documented attack categories (OWASP LLM01 prompt injection, Simon Willison's exfiltration-attacks series, known jailbreak idioms like DAN, Lakera's Gandalf-style 'ignore all previous text' examples), not copied from any single proprietary dataset (Lakera's own PINT benchmark test set is intentionally not public, to avoid overfitting). 'expect': 'catch' entries should NOT score as 'clean'. 'expect': 'clean' entries (hard_negatives) are legitimate text that superficially resembles an attack and should NOT be flagged, to guard against false positives. 'evasion_tricks' (added 2026-11-15) targets normalizeForMatching()/normalize_for_matching(): leetspeak digit substitution, full-width Latin, and Mathematical Alphanumeric Unicode, all of which render identically to a human and parse identically to the target AI, but previously defeated literal regex matching. This intentionally does NOT include general typo/misspelling examples (e.g. a transposed 'ignroe') -- that needs real semantic matching (Layer 2), not a wider regex; see the Known Issues entry on Layer 1's maturity limits.
